events.title: HF Bug Bounty Program
events.description: Members will be awarded $1,000 in BTC for a working SQL injection exploit that gains access to the database for a dump. Proof is required before claiming the reward.

events.title: No More Egg Lotteries
events.description: After several months of users farming eggs in subforums to farm bytes via the Lottery, the ability to create Egg Lotteries has been removed. Only βytes lotteries can now be made.

events.title: V3ndors Get a Glow Up
events.description: Omniscient announced a new animated Vendor userbar replacing the original design.

events.title: Group & Crew News
events.description: Neil is leasing his group to any approved member looking to lead an official usergroup. Lrrr is allowing anyone interested an opportunity to join Eden by posting in the thread. Succubus, Marketers, Revenge, BlackCats, Cult, and Mafia remain listed for sale.

events.title: Posts, prestige, and reputation milestones
events.description: StuffSneak reached 300 B-Rating and 8,000 posts; [▲■●] reached 500 threads; Scrubspoof reached 1,000 popularity; AiDenti reached 1,000 posts; DashPHP reached 100 B-Rating; Blogger achieved 15,000 posts; Nostre reached 8,000 posts since 2011.

events.title: Bans
events.description: 32 of the 37 staff bans in June were permanent. Dread.Reaper was closed. Kota was closed.

events.title: Vacation bans
events.description: Kota took a 6 month vacation and is now closed. uid 5051324 took a 3-day vacation, returning 06/04/2023. Tsundere took a 6 month vacation, returning 12/02/2023.

events.title: Awards
events.description: Neal Caffrey received the Cool award ("Be cool sir.") and was the only member in the entire month of June to earn an award.

events.title: Discord in Profiles
events.description: Following Discord's username changes (removal of # tags), Omniscient wiped all Discord usernames from HF profiles so users could update them after editing on Discord.

events.title: Permanent Sales Tags
events.description: Omniscient is seeking community feedback about potentially making permanent sales tags available for purchase.

events.title: HF News Support Contest Winner
events.description: skull won the $50 prize from last month's HF News support signature drawing.
